evidence.notes: Local execution returns a deterministic email verification token without contacting a live identity service.
Local execution returns an empty UserOrgInfo list without contacting a live identity lookup service.
Local execution accepts Splunk log calls without contacting a live logging service.

source.content: @isTest private class TrailblazerIdentityLocalEvidenceTest { @isTest static void helperCallsAreDeterministic() { String token = TrailblazerIdentity.generateUserEmailVerificationToken('00D000000000001', UserInfo.getUserId(), 'local@example.invalid'); System.assertEquals('local-email-verification-token', token); List<Auth.UserOrgInfo> orgs = TrailblazerIdentity.getUserOrgInfo(new List<String>{'local@example.invalid'}); System.assertEquals(0, orgs.size()); TrailblazerIdentity.splunkLog('local', 'message'); } }
